english.title: Use motor vehicle - material not maintained - seat belt

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), fitted with a **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF BELT..) seat belt in accordance with regulation 47 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, when the material which formed the said belt was not maintained free from cuts or other visible faults which would be likely to affect adversely the performance of the belt when under stress.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 48(4)(e) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used a motor vehicle on a road fitted with a seat belt
the material which formed the belt was not maintained
free from cuts/other visible faults
likely to affect adversely the performance of the belt under stress

english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant used on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) fitted with a **(..SPECIFY LOCATION OF BELT..) seat belt. The material which formed the belt was **(..SPECIFY DEFECT..). As a result, the performance of the belt when under stress was likely to be adversely affected.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale

Level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

Fixed penalty ticket - fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
